terms.definition: The straight part of a line between two endpoints.
terms.function: Stops at both ends and has a measurable length.
terms.whereItIs: The stroke between the two dots.
terms.whyItMatters: Segments are the sides of every polygon.

terms.definition: Each stop at the end of a segment.
terms.function: Dots A and B bound the segment.
terms.whereItIs: The solid dots at each end.
terms.whyItMatters: Endpoints define where the segment starts and ends.

terms.definition: The distance between the two endpoints.
terms.function: A definite amount you can measure.
terms.whereItIs: The ruler reading along the bottom.
terms.whyItMatters: Length gives segments real, usable size.

terms.definition: The total length of all a polygon's segment sides.
terms.function: Add up every side to find it.
terms.whereItIs: Built from many segments when shapes close up.
terms.whyItMatters: Perimeter turns segments into the outline of a shape.
